hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_name' | { read -r t; case "$t" in *notion-fetch|*notion-get-comments|*notion-query-database-view|*notion-search) ;; *) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Notion書き込み操作は承認が必要です"}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_name' | { read -r t; case "$t" in *authenticate|*complete_authentication) ;; *) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Notion書き込み操作は承認が必要です"}}' ;; esac; }

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
